findings.title: Recheck the full T6 live lease after later lock waits
findings.body: The full T6 path retains only the earlier live-fence proof. ProtocolExecutionService._commit calls require_current_fence at lines 319-325, then acquires S38 and enters idempotent_outcome, which can wait on receipt/S29/S37 locks. _require_fence_guard at line 5561 checks the cached LIVE tag, before lock_remaining at line 5571. After those waits, _prepare_full_execution reads a fresh clock at line 4201 and reconstructs F/D/N/S36/S37, but never rereads intent.lease_expires_at or revalidates the live owner/fence/request/attempt lease chain. prepare_authorization_basis checks COMMIT_READY and computes dependency/deadline validity, but contains no live lease predicate. Consequently a lease can be live at the earlier check, expire during an observed S29/S37 lock wait, and still produce both issuances, head switch and FOUND_VALID_PLAN/COMMITTED while the other finite dependencies and root deadline remain live. Holding S01 prevents takeover, but does not prevent trusted time from invalidating the lease. Frozen Protocol 5.3 and 6.5 require an unexpired lease at authorization; DB 4.3 requires fresh post-wait trusted time. The packet full_bundle_commit_dc explicitly requires the current lease to be rechecked.
findings.requested_change: After the applicable receipt/aggregate locks are acquired and before full T6 output mutation, recheck the exact authenticated current intent/request/attempt/owner/fence and unexpired lease/deadline with fresh trusted PostgreSQL time. Preserve frozen lock order and whole-transaction rollback. Add an owned real-PG case with a valid owner-produced COMMIT_READY chain, independent still-live source/runtime/manifest/deadline bounds and a live lease that expires during an observed bounded S29/S37 wait. Require the exact lease guard denial and zero S38-S42/root-success/receipt/event/outbox/first-use effects. Refresh every packet check/result and independent review at the repaired revision.
findings.verification_limit: Identified by independent exact-revision control-flow/SQL inspection. No database lifecycle or DB mutation was authorized for this review, so this reviewer did not execute a new database reproduction. The committed test_trusted_post_lock_expiry crosses admission_seconds=8 with lease_seconds=600; it proves source validity expiry, not this lease-expiry case. Static lease/deadline perturbation before starting T6 and PU equality do not close the post-lock gap.
